(async()=>{ const p=__app.player, v=p.video, view=p.view; v.pause(); v.currentTime=1; await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,800)); const gl=view.renderer.getContext(); const W=gl.drawingBufferWidth,H=gl.drawingBufferHeight; const stats=()=>{ view.render(); const d=new Uint8Array(W*H*4); gl.readPixels(0,0,W,H,gl.RGBA,gl.UNSIGNED_BYTE,d); let n=0,S=0,L=0; for(let i=0;i<d.length;i+=4){ const r=d[i],g=d[i+1],b=d[i+2],mx=Math.max(r,g,b),mn=Math.min(r,g,b); if(mx<8) continue; n++; S+=(mx-mn)/mx; L+=0.2126*r+0.7152*g+0.0722*b; } return {sat:+(S/n).toFixed(3), luma:+(L/n).toFixed(1)}; }; view.setVibrance(0); const off=stats(); view.setVibrance(0.5); const on=stats(); view.setVibrance(1); const full=stats(); view.setVibrance(0); return {off,on50:on,on100:full, gain50: ((on.sat/off.sat-1)*100).toFixed(1)+'%'}; })()
